description: Extract public business contact details from a website: email addresses (mailto, visible text incl. [at]/[dot] obfuscation, Cloudflare-protected, JSON-LD) tagged role/personal and same-domain, phone numbers (tel: links, JSON-LD, text), social profiles (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, TikTok, Mastodon, ...; share links ignored), JSON-LD organization name/address and contact-form URLs. Follows up to 3 same-site contact/impressum/about pages. SSRF-safe fetching; respect GDPR/CAN-SPAM when using results. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/contact-extract

crawl.description: Also fetch likely contact/impressum/about pages on the same host (default true)

max_pages.description: Total pages to fetch including the first, 1-4 (default 3)

url.description: Website URL or bare domain (http/https; ports 80, 443, 8080, 8443)

name: contact_extract
title: Contact Extract
